rules.name: Gung-Ho!
rules.description: Today, the Marines will meet the Japanese's ferocity with their own aggression, determination and will to win, as well their firepower. Gain an extra D3 for each Command and Controll roll - so in Platoon-level games, roll 2D6 + 1D3, etc.
